name: lysine methyltransferase 5A
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: KMT5A encodes n-lysine methyltransferase KMT5A. Annotated molecular activities include histone methyltransferase activity and lysine N-methyltransferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
